steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Sunni and Shi'a Muslims have different frameworks for their core beliefs. Sunni Islam is based on the Six Articles of Faith ; Shi'a Islam is based on the Five Roots of Usul ad-Din . They share most beliefs but emphasise different aspects. | Exam Tip: Both traditions share belief in Tawhid, prophethood and the afterlife. The key difference is the Imamate — Shi'a Muslims believe God appointed twelve Imams as spiritual leaders after Muhammad, while Sunni Muslims do not accept this. Sunni Islam includes belief in angels and holy books as separate articles; Shi'a Islam combines prophethood into one root. | RS Exam Tips — The Six Articles and Five Roots: 1.
